description: We are a two-member team combining data analytics and software engineering: a Business Data Analytics student  with experience in applied ML, NLP and agentic AI , and a software engineer who builds the application layer. For Flame in Freefall, we are building an AI-powered dashboard that uses retrieval-augmented generation to search, rank and explain NASA’s microgravity combustion experiments. Our goal is to help engineers quickly find the research that matters for fire safety in spacecraft
